body.name: Finite stratum union-envelope program
body.construction: For each \(x\), let \(\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)=(1,0,a^{\prime},0)^{\prime}\), \(\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)=(0,1,0,d^{\prime})^{\prime}\), and \(c(a,d)=\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)-\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)\). The program \(\mathrm{QP}_x\) minimizes \(\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)\) over \(a\in\mathbb R^J\) and \(d\in\mathbb R^T\), subject to \(\Omega_x^{1/2}c(a,d)=0\); among tied pairs it selects the Euclidean minimum-norm pair \((a_x^U,d_x^U)\). The \(J\)-coordinate PT block is generated by the profiled treated-versus-donor map and has the known null direction \(\mathbf 1_J\).
